classifications.reason: The human-power, riding and wheel language admits this class, and the exception names mopeds rather than excluding the bicycle class.
Any electric bicycle admitted must satisfy the definition's human-power, riding and wheel requirements and therefore carries the proposed included covering class ru.bicycle.
Any electric scooter admitted is necessarily a human-powered ridden wheeled device under the admitting words and thus satisfies the quoted ru.bicycle contract.
The express words 'except a moped' remove the jurisdiction-classed mopeds described by this class's contract.
The words do not require exclusively human propulsion, but any motor vehicle admitted must satisfy the human-powered ridden wheeled-device contract of ru.bicycle.
Any motorcycle admitted must meet the human-power, riding and wheel requirements and escape the moped exception, so every admitted member carries ru.bicycle.
Motor propulsion and passenger capacity do not negate the admitting requirements, and any bus satisfying those requirements necessarily carries ru.bicycle.
School designation and markings do not alter the requirement that every admitted school bus be a human-powered ridden wheeled device satisfying ru.bicycle.
Transit service does not displace the definition's requirements, so any admitted transit bus necessarily satisfies the quoted ru.bicycle contract.
Any admitted member of either branch of this class must satisfy the human-power, riding and wheel requirements and consequently carries ru.bicycle.
For-hire status and markings do not prevent coverage because every taxicab the definition admits must satisfy the quoted ru.bicycle contract.
Neither motor propulsion nor a goods-carrying body expressly prevents human propulsion, and every admitted truck must satisfy the ru.bicycle contract.
Commercial mass or licensing does not displace the admitting requirements, which make every admitted member a human-powered ridden wheeled device carrying ru.bicycle.
Emergency designation does not alter the admitting requirements, so every admitted emergency vehicle satisfies ru.bicycle without any assumption about responding conduct.
A fire-fighting purpose does not displace the human-power, riding and wheel requirements that make every admitted member carry ru.bicycle.
Official or contracted road service does not alter the requirement that every admitted member satisfy the quoted human-powered ridden wheeled-vehicle contract of ru.bicycle.
The bicycle definition contains no rail exception, and any on-track equipment it admits must satisfy the human-power, riding and wheel requirements establishing ru.bicycle coverage.
Any drawn vehicle or combination admitted under the definition must itself satisfy the human-power, riding and wheel requirements and therefore carries ru.bicycle.
The admitting words describe a device upon which a person may ride, not the person who constitutes a member of ru.pedestrian.
A child pedestrian is a person, whereas the admitting words reach only the ridden device.
This class describes a pedestrian person, not the human-powered device admitted by the definition.
